title: The Revolt of the Batavians (AD 69-70)
lead: The rising of the Batavians, a people at the mouth of the Rhine, under their noble and Roman officer Julius Civilis in AD 69 to 70. It drew in Gallic leaders and destroyed Roman camps. Josephus and Dio say Petilius Cerialis put it down (Josephus, War 7.4.2; Dio 65.3). Tacitus tells it in Histories 4:12-4:37, 4:54-4:79, 4:85-4:86 and 5:14-5:26, where the surviving text breaks off; Josephus gives it a paragraph (War 7.4.2). It is not in the Bible; it matters here as the army and politics of the months when Jerusalem was under siege.
